items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: Jimm Apollo was a good violin player, though. He was just like, he was classed just like Emmanuel, uh, Man Manera and, uh, uh, uh, Peter Bocot. All of them good violin players.

ctx.x: Did they ever have any solo players then? No. Did they have any solo players? Solo, no. No. Not as I love, no. No. Tom Mitchell used to tell me about them. He said you didn't have a band on them.

I didn't have a band on them, so. Jimm Apollo was a good violin player, though. He was just like, he was classed just like Emmanuel, uh, Man Manera and, uh, uh, uh, Peter Bocot. All of them good violin players. Sight readers.
What about the Lindsey family? Did you know Johnny and Herbert and their daddy?
